aviso.condiciones.texto: Each property's details are published in good faith and may change; they are not a contractual offer. Confirm them before making a decision.
aviso.objeto.texto: A catalogue of properties for sale and a form to request a viewing.
aviso.propiedad.texto: Texts and photographs belong to their owners. Do not reuse them without permission.
aviso.titular.texto: Company name, tax ID, address and professional registration number: [PENDING: to be supplied by the owner].
catalog.empty: No listings published right now. We are out visiting new homes — check back in a few days.
catalog.error: We could not open the catalogue. Reload the page or give us a call.
cookies.cuales.texto: Cookieless analytics (Umami, self-hosted), which counts visits in aggregate without identifying you, and the language you choose, which stays in your browser.
cookies.gestion.texto: You can clear this site's storage from your browser whenever you like; the only thing you lose is the language you picked.
cookies.que.texto: This site uses no advertising cookies and no cross-site tracking, so you will not see a banner asking for permission.
footer.claim: Homes we have walked through before showing them to you.
footer.rgpd: Your data is used only to answer your enquiry (GDPR). We never share it with third parties for their advertising.
form.consent: I agree to be contacted about this property. See the privacy policy.
form.error: It could not be sent — try again or give us a call.

privacidad.base.texto: Your consent, given by ticking the box in the form, and the pre-contractual steps you ask us to take.
privacidad.derechos.texto: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability. Write to [PENDING: to be supplied by the owner] and we will answer.
privacidad.intro.texto: If you leave your details in the form, we use them to call you about that property. Nothing else.
privacidad.para.texto: To answer you and arrange the viewing. We do no profiling and no automated decisions, and we do not send you advertising you have not asked for.
privacidad.plazo.texto: For as long as the enquiry lasts and for the period the law requires afterwards. You can ask us to delete them sooner.
privacidad.que.texto: What the form asks for: name, phone, email if you write one, and the message. We also store the property you asked about, the date, and the wording of the consent you accepted.
privacidad.quien.texto: The owner of this site. Company name, address and tax ID: [PENDING: to be supplied by the owner].
privacidad.reclamacion.texto: You can complain to your country's supervisory authority. In Spain that is the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (aepd.es).
privacidad.reclamacion.titulo: If you think we are getting it wrong
privacidad.terceros.texto: The data is stored in our own database hosted in the European Union. This site also uses cookieless analytics (Umami, self-hosted) and error capture (GlitchTip, self-hosted); neither receives what you type into the form.
